text: I posted a Reel. Boom, it blew up.
Manychat sent the links, and I got... 126 DMs!
style: rising shock, a little laugh of disbelief on the number

text: How am I supposed to pitch my offer to all of them? It's 9 p.m.!
If I reply too late, they'll forget me! So all of that... for nothing?
style: worried and dramatic, slower on the last words, deflated

text: Quick, I need to hire a setter. But I have to train them, pay them commission... and what if they reply with total cringe like
style: hurried and stressed, talking fast to himself

text: Hey babe! Ready to ten-x your life?
style: mocking impression of a cheesy, over-the-top hype salesperson, exaggerated and funny

text: Wait... what's this? ManySetter? An AI setter that plugs into my Manychat... and talks exactly like me?
style: intrigued, slowing down, curious and hopeful

text: Okay, let's try. I give it my sales page... two minutes later, it knows my offer by heart.
It answers every DM, handles the "I need to think about it"... and when someone's a fit, it books the call. Right in the DM.

Oh, and it's sneaky. It waits a beat before replying... like a real human would. Every lead gets an AI summary, so I know exactly who I'm calling. And my sales team? They get the stats. Conversations, qualified leads, calls booked.
style: playful and impressed, confiding, quick rhythmic list at the end

text: Next morning. Coffee in hand... and the calls are already in my calendar. No setter. No commission. And it still sounds like me.
style: relaxed, relieved, warm smile, calm but not slow

text: Got a Reel coming up? Build your setter for free. No card. If your program's fifteen hundred bucks, one new client pays for the whole year.
style: friendly, direct to the viewer, confident and quick

text: ManySetter. Your DMs on autopilot... in your voice. ManySetter dot com.
style: warm, confident, a smile, landing the brand
